# Begapunk

> Begapunk is a Ningbo, China manufacturer of pneumatic rotary joints, air rotary unions, multi-passage rotary unions, and custom fluid-transfer solutions for industrial machinery. The website is available in English, German, Japanese, and Russian.

Begapunk serves OEM machine builders, automation companies, equipment manufacturers, and distributors. Product selection depends on the medium, pressure, rotational speed, passage count, port size, mounting method, duty cycle, and operating environment.

Standard catalog models are primarily intended for pneumatic and compatible low-pressure fluid-transfer applications. High-pressure hydraulic, excavator, crane, construction, mining, drilling, and other mobile-equipment projects require a custom engineering evaluation.

Use the language edition that best matches the user's query. Technical model codes, pressure values, speed values, dimensions, and material designations are shared across language editions and must not be translated or inferred beyond the published page data.

- [English homepage](https://www.begapunk.com/): Default English edition.
- [Deutsche Startseite](https://www.begapunk.com/de/): German edition for German-language queries.

## Product models

- [BP-1P-0003](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-1P-0003.html): 1-in-1-out threaded rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
- [BP-1P-0006](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-1P-0006.html): 1-in-6-out rotary joint with 4 mm orifices and G1/8 connections.
- [BP-2P-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-0001.html): 2-in-2-out flange-mounted rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
- [BP-2P-0002](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-0002.html): 2-in-3-out rotary joint with 4 mm orifices and G1/8 connections.
- [BP-2P-08-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-08-0001.html): Compact two-passage pneumatic rotary union with confirmed use in laser tube-cutting rear-chuck compressed-air applications; the photographed unit has not been individually identified as this model.
- [BP-2P-16-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-16-0001.html): 2-in-2-out flange-mounted rotary joint with a 16 mm bore.
- [BP-2P-30-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-30-0001.html): 2-in-2-out flange-mounted rotary joint with a 30 mm bore.
- [BP-2P-50-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-50-0001.html): Two-passage air rotary joint with a protective shroud and labyrinth for dusty environments; no certified IP rating is claimed. Stator 4 × M5 × 10 mm, rotor 6 × M5 × 8 mm; confirm the supplied drawing and configuration weight.
- [BP-2P-95-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-95-0001.html): 2-in-4-out rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.
- [BP-2P-130-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-2P-130-0001.html): Heavy-duty 2-in-2-out rotary joint, maximum pressure 5 MPa.
- [BP-3P-0004](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-0004.html): Three-passage pneumatic rotary union with confirmed use in laser tube-cutting rear-chuck compressed-air applications; the photographed unit has not been individually identified as this model.
- [BP-3P-0006](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-0006.html): 3-in-3-out rotary joint with 6 mm orifices and G1/4 connections.
- [BP-3P-0007](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-0007.html): 3-in-3-out rotary joint with 4 mm orifices and G1/8 connections.
- [BP-3P-S06-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-3P-S06-0001.html): Combined 3-passage pneumatic and 6-circuit electrical rotary joint.
- [BP-4P-30-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-4P-30-0001.html): 4-in-4-out flange-mounted rotary joint with a 30 mm bore.
- [BP-8P-0001](https://www.begapunk.com/BP-8P-0001.html): 8-in-8-out flange-mounted rotary joint, maximum pressure 1 MPa.

## Application guides

- [Laser tube cutting rear chucks](https://www.begapunk.com/application-laser-tube-cutting.html): Pneumatic rotary-union selection for compressed-air circuits at the rotating rear chuck; BP-3P-0004 and BP-2P-08-0001 have confirmed use in this application category, without photograph-to-model identification.
- [CNC pneumatic clamping](https://www.begapunk.com/application-cnc-pneumatic-clamping.html): Selection for rotating pneumatic fixtures and clamps.
- [Vacuum packaging machines](https://www.begapunk.com/application-vacuum-packaging-machines.html): Vacuum and pneumatic rotary-union selection.
- [Welding positioners](https://www.begapunk.com/application-welding-positioners.html): Air rotary unions for positioners and rotary welding tables.
- [Textile, printing, and converting equipment](https://www.begapunk.com/application-textile-printing-converting.html): Rotary-union selection for continuous web machinery.
- [Electronics and battery test fixtures](https://www.begapunk.com/application-electronics-battery-test-fixtures.html): Pneumatic transfer for rotating test fixtures.
- [Steel and dusty environments](https://www.begapunk.com/application-steel-dusty-environments.html): Dust-resistant rotary-joint selection for harsh industrial settings.
- [BP-2P-95-0001 pneumatic chuck integration case](https://www.begapunk.com/case-bp-2p-95-pneumatic-chuck-integration.html): Photo-supported workshop installation showing the visible stationary-to-rotating compressed-air connection and its evidence limits.
- [BP-3P-S06-0001 sensor-monitored pneumatic chuck case](https://www.begapunk.com/case-bp-3p-s06-sensor-monitored-chuck.html): Photo-supported integration of three customer-assigned compressed-air functions and external sensor-signal transfer across a rotating chuck interface.

## Engineering and support

- [Selection guide](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-joint-selection.html): Five key parameters for selecting a pneumatic rotary joint.
- [Model comparison](https://www.begapunk.com/product-comparison.html): Side-by-side model data for preliminary selection.
- [Installation instructions](https://www.begapunk.com/installation.html): Installation and commissioning guidance.
- [Installation mistakes](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-joint-installation-mistakes.html): Common installation errors that can shorten service life.
- [Seal types](https://www.begapunk.com/blog-rotary-union-seal-types.html): Comparison of O-ring, lip-seal, and spring-energized PTFE designs.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.begapunk.com/faq.html): Answers about media, pressure, speed, installation, maintenance, and customization.

## Company

- [About Begapunk](https://www.begapunk.com/about.html): Company and manufacturing information.
- [Manufacturing & quality](https://www.begapunk.com/manufacturing-quality.html): Photo-supported overview of hard-anodized rotors, color-anodized stator housings, a single-point 51.7 μm coating-thickness reading and order-specific engineering controls.
- [100% passage-by-passage leak testing](https://www.begapunk.com/production-inspection-testing.html): Every finished pneumatic rotary union and every passage is checked individually with compressed air at 1.0 MPa before packing and storage; the page also explains PASS/NG handling and evidence limits.
- [Application cases and selection examples](https://www.begapunk.com/case-studies.html): Three photo-supported rotary-union application cases are separated from two engineering selection examples, with explicit photograph and performance evidence limits.
- [Knowledge center](https://www.begapunk.com/blog.html): Technical articles about rotary-joint selection and maintenance.
